name: Search (proposal engine)
question: Is the search aimed at my target, and does it stay where the model is trusted?
purpose: Whether proposals come from a region the model has seen, and whether they are conditioned on the target at all.
verdict_rule: the worst grade of its graded metrics
caveats: On-manifold sampling and the novelty rule conflict: it samples between known structures, so with novelty required it returned 0 candidates in 3 of 4 arms. The search mode is therefore a choice by goal, not a quality setting.

metrics.name: Latent length ratio
metrics.definition: Median length of the final search latents divided by the median length of training structure latents.
metrics.meaning_good: The search stays at the scale the model was trained on.
metrics.meaning_bad: The search left the scale of the training latents, so the property head is being read far outside its domain.
metrics.remedy: Constrain the search to the unit sphere.

metrics.name: Distance to the data manifold
metrics.definition: Median largest cosine between a final search latent and any training structure latent.
metrics.meaning_good: Proposals come from the populated part of the latent space.
metrics.meaning_bad: Proposals come from empty latent space, where nothing was ever trained.
metrics.remedy: Sample between nearest real structure latents instead of following a gradient.

metrics.name: Raw steering, before any filter
metrics.definition: Spearman correlation between the requested target and the true property of the raw proposals, with no filtering applied.
metrics.meaning_good: The proposals themselves are conditioned on the target; the result is not an artefact of filtering.
metrics.meaning_bad: The search is not conditioned on the target: any apparent success comes from the filter alone.
metrics.remedy: Aim the search with the property latent; check the alignment block.
metrics.reference_note: Final configuration +0.85 (replicate +0.84) against about 0 for random proposals. This is the only clean evidence of real conditioning, because it is measured before filtering.

metrics.name: Seed reproducibility
metrics.definition: Difference in hit rate, in percentage points, between two training seeds of the same configuration.
metrics.meaning_good: The result is reproducible across seeds.
metrics.meaning_bad: The result depends on the seed, so a single run must not be reported as an improvement.
metrics.remedy: Always run at least two seeds and report the range.
metrics.reference_note: Full fix 67.3 vs 65.5 (1.8 points). On-manifold search 83.3 vs 56.8 (26.5 points), which is why its advantage over the plain baseline is reported as unproven.
